articles.summary: ATLANTA, June 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aveanna Healthcare Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAH), a leading, diversified home care platform focused on providing care to medically complex, high-cost patient populations, today announced that it completed its acquisition of Family First Holding, LLC
articles.title: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings Completes Acquisition of Family First Homecare and Updates Full Year 2026 Guidance
